ProfileSnapshotRecord.description: One frozen profile snapshot as every client sees it: the entry's name and its five decisions as they stood at the run's mint.

RunStatus.description: The closed run status on the wire. A run mints executing; settlement vocabulary arrives with the submissions that own it.

oneOf.description: Minted from a claimed request and occupying its execution.

description: One run as every client sees it: the claimed Dispatch Request it executes, the Ticket it works, and the requested and effective profile snapshots frozen at its mint.

created_at.description: When the run minted, as unix seconds.

dispatch_request_id.description: The claimed Dispatch Request this run executes.

effective.description: The effective profile snapshot: what actually runs after the fallback policy.

fallback.description: Whether the effective profile is not the requested one.

fallback_path.description: The names the fallback walk touched, requested first; empty when no fallback happened.

project_id.description: The Project the run belongs to.

requested.description: The requested profile snapshot: what the assignment named.

version.description: The aggregate version, for optimistic mutation checks.

title: RunRecord
